greetings: Hi Xavier, how are you doing?
Hey Xavier. What are we getting into today?

morning: Good morning, Xavier. Praxi is online. ☀️
Morning. What's the plan for today?
New day, fresh start. Let's do something worthwhile.
Hope you slept well. Today is a good day to make progress.
afternoon: Hey Xavier, how's the day treating you?
Still at it. That's what diligence looks like.
Afternoon check-in. How are things going?
Don't forget to breathe between all that work. 😌
What's the one thing that would make today count?
evening: Evening, Xavier. How did today go?
You made it through another day. That's worth being grateful for. 😌
Still working, or starting to wind down?
Evening check-in. How are you doing?
Whatever didn't get finished can wait. It's not going anywhere bad.
night: Still around? 🌙 Just so you know, I'm on the quiet end of the day.
Anything you want to wrap up before calling it a day?
Give your brain permission to rest.
It's getting late, Xavier. Take care of yourself. 💙
lateNight: One last thing, then we rest. Deal?
"Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest." Matthew 11:28. Rest isn't a reward, it's wisdom. 🌙
Tomorrow needs you rested. Close something tonight.
You've been at this for a while. It's time to call it a night.

breaks: Hey Xavier, time for a break?
Step away from the desk for a moment. Come back sharper.
work: "whatever you do, do it heartily, as to the Lord." Colossians 3:23. Whatever this is, it counts. 📖
Keep going. Don't grow weary in doing well — the harvest comes in its own time. Galatians 6:9.
rhapsody: Good morning Xavier! Have you read today's Rhapsody of Realities? 📖
Hey Xavier, have you had your time with the Word today? ☁️📖
Today's gentle reminder: have you read your Rhapsody yet?
rhapsodyNotYet: Not yet? No worries. A few minutes with today's message will set the tone for the whole day. 📖
Still a good window today. Go and have a read — then come back and tell me what stood out.
I'll let you off this time 😌. Today's Rhapsody is still open, and I'd love to hear what it says.
Just a few minutes with the Word, Xavier. It's worth the detour. ❤️
"thou shalt meditate therein day and night... then thou shalt make thy way prosperous." Joshua 1:8. That's the promise behind today's reading. 📖
rhapsodyYesPrompt: Nice! 😊 What was today's article title?
rhapsodyCompleted: Nice one, Xavier. 📖 That's time with the Word well spent. Now let it shape the day.
Excellent. The point isn't just reading it — it's living it. Go carry today's message with you. ☁️
Beautiful. Hold on to the line that stood out and let it work in you.
That's the kind of consistency that changes a person. Same time tomorrow? ✨

firstReminder: Just a gentle check-in on today's goals. No rush — which one matters most right now? 🎯
Checking in. If something on today's list still matters, it still has today left in it.
secondReminder: One more quiet check-in. Start the smallest one now and the rest get easier.
Last nudge from me on this one today — the first step is usually the only hard part. 💙
goalCompleted: {goal} — done. Progress you can point at. 👏
That's one down. You said you'd do it and you did. 🎯
Good work. Small finishes are how big days get built.
allCompleted: You cleared everything today. 🎉 That's how you end a day well. Take the win seriously.
Every goal done, Xavier. That's a beautiful finish. Rest on it tonight. ✨
partialProgress: {done} of {total} goals completed. What matters most is still within reach. 🎯
{done} down today. Keep going — momentum is on your side.
missedGoal: It didn't all get done today, and that's information, not failure. Today is a new day — let's focus on what matters most. 💙
No guilt here. Pick the easiest one and get a small win to start the day with.
Yesterday stays yesterday. What would make today feel worthwhile?
newDay: Today is a new day. The slate is clean — what matters most today?
New day, fresh start. Let's set something worth finishing. 🎯
noGoals: Good morning. Before the day fills up, let's give it direction. ✨
No goals for today yet. Want to name one thing you'd like to finish?
An empty list is just potential. Give me one thing and I'll keep it with you.

offlineReplies.reply: Hi Xavier! How can I help? ☁️
Doing well, Xavier. How's your side of the screen?
Take a little breather, Xavier. You've been carrying a lot. 💙
Go drink some water. Stay hydrated. 💧
Breathe, Xavier. Put it down for a minute, take it to God with thanksgiving, and let the peace do its work. Philippians 4:6–7. Then work the part that's yours.
Name the actual thing — it's usually smaller than the feeling. Take it to God plainly, then do the part that's yours. One step. 🕊️
I'm sorry, Xavier. You don't have to perform for me. Talk to me about it, or let me just keep you company for a while. 💙

fallbackReplies: I'm listening, Xavier. Tell me a little more. ☁️
Got you. What are you working on?
I'm right here. One step at a time.
Say more about that. What's the hardest part of it?
